steps.en: Prepare Python 3.11+, Git and the source checkout
steps.zh: 准备 Python 3.11+、Git 与源码环境

steps.en: Check the trusted offline task and measure its no-adapter baseline
steps.zh: 检查可信离线任务，测无适配器基线

steps.en: Train the included scripted adapter learner
steps.zh: 启动内置脚本适配器学习器

steps.en: Collect feedback, edit the output rule and version the adapter
steps.zh: 收集反馈，修改输出规则并保存版本

steps.en: Evaluate root and final separately, then request a fresh Codex workspace
steps.zh: 分别评测起始和最终版，再生成新 Codex 工作区

steps.en: Write the learned instruction into workspace files; do not launch the host
steps.zh: 把学到的指令写入工作区文件，不启动宿主

value.en: An inspectable feedback-to-adapter-to-host cycle, without changing model weights
value.zh: 得到可检查的反馈、适配器、宿主交接链，不改模型权重
